title: EC60128: Linear Algebra And Error Control Techniques
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: NoneGroups, Fields, Galois fields, basic properties,
computational polynomials. Vector spaces, matrices, combinational sets,
Projective geometry sets, Euclidian geometry sets. ARQ techniques and
performance. Block cyclic code theory, weight distribution, shortened cyclic
codes, Golay, RS codes, Error trapping and majority logic decoding of cyclic
codes. Finite geometry coding. Sequential decoding convolution codes. Burst
error correcting block and convolution codes. Product codes, Concatenated
codes. Coding and modulation, Comparison of different coding schemes.
